title: Clockwork Revolution
description: Clockwork Revolution is an assembly about technological progress: from the first Create mechanisms to automated Mekanism factories with smart logistics. For those who want to build complex production chains in a vibrant, dangerous world.
body:
Clockwork Revolution
Technical assembly for Minecraft 1.20.1

What's it?
The assembly is about technology and automation. You will start with simple Create mechanisms, build Mekanism factories and create a fully automated base with smart logistics. No magic, just engineering.

What's inside?
✅Create - gears, conveyors, cool mechanisms
✅ Mekanism - advanced factories, x5 ore processing
✅Refined Storage - digital storage, avtokraft
✅Sophisticated Storage — smart chests and backpacks
✅ Alex's Mobs - live and dangerous mobs in the world
✅Optimization - shaders, smooth interfaces, stable FPS

What should I do in the build?
First, manual mining, the first Create mechanisms

Then there are the automatic farms, the factories of Mekanism

In the end, it's a mega factory where everything is self-produced.

Requirements
Minecraft 1.20.1 with Forge

6-8 GB of RAM (allocate in the launcher)

Video card for shaders (optional)

Ideal for those who like to build factories, set up logistics and see how everything works by itself.

The build has been tested for compatibility, all mods work together.
